claims: For the 2026 tax season, taxpayers can request an automatic extension to file their federal income tax return until October 15, 2026.
The extension request must be filed by April 15, 2026.
The extension request must be filed using Form 4868.
An extension grants more time to file, not to pay.
Estimated taxes owed are still due by April 15, 2026, to avoid penalties.
IRS Free File can be used to submit Form 4868 electronically at no cost.
Paying all or part of estimated taxes via IRS Direct Pay, debit/credit card, or EFTPS and selecting "Extension" as the reason avoids the need to file a separate Form 4868.
A paper Form 4868 mailed to the IRS must be postmarked by April 15, 2026.
Taxpayers must pay 90% of their total tax liability by April 15, 2026 to avoid estimated payment penalties.
U.S. citizens living outside the country may receive an automatic two-month extension.
Taxpayers in specific declared disaster areas may have postponed deadlines.
Taxpayers impacted by Winter Storm Fern in Tennessee may have postponed deadlines
